hooks.command: FILE=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('file_path',''))" 2>/dev/null); case "$FILE" in *.js) node --input-type=module --eval "" < /dev/null 2>/dev/null; npx --yes --quiet prettier --write "$FILE" 2>/dev/null || true ;; *.css|*.html) npx --yes --quiet prettier --write "$FILE" 2>/dev/null || true ;; esac
